role_summary: Senior leadership role focused on driving business growth and strategy through deep-dive predictive and diagnostic analytics within marketing and distribution channels.
must_have_requirements: 12+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or strategy
Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, or related
Proven experience in customer segmentation and behavioral analysis
Expertise in translating complex analytical outputs into executive-level strategic recommendations
Advanced proficiency in statistical modeling and data transformation techniques
nice_to_have_requirements: Master's degree in a quantitative field
Domain expertise in Insurance or Financial Services industry
Experience managing external vendors and technology partners
Proven track record of driving cross-selling and retention strategies

scoring_criteria.name: Years of Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Requires high level of maturity and strategic depth to influence leadership.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: 10-11 years may be considered if impact is high

scoring_criteria.name: Strategic Insight Generation
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Core function is to deliver actionable growth strategies, not just reporting.

scoring_criteria.name: Advanced Statistical Modeling
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Required to uncover complex patterns in digital/customer behavior.

scoring_criteria.name: Insurance/Financial Knowledge
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Domain expertise minimizes onboarding and improves contextual relevance.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Manageable if other analytics skills are superior

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Influence
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must translate data into business language for senior leaders.

scoring_criteria.name: Customer Lifecycle Analytics
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Direct focus on acquisition, retention, and upsell performance.

scoring_criteria.name: Technical Breadth
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must implement innovative analytical approaches and manage technology vendors.

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership & Strategy
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Role is lead-level and requires guiding cross-functional data initiatives.

summary_focus: Highlight the 'how'—how you used data to guide business strategy, specifically in financial services or consumer retail.
do_not_overclaim: Avoid overstating purely academic projects; focus on enterprise-grade, high-value business outcomes.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Position yourself as an analytical anchor who bridges the gap between raw data and tangible revenue growth.
bridge_gaps_honestly: If domain experience is in a different sector, emphasize the universality of customer behavior analytics across complex, highly regulated retail environments.
